description: Implement Rally protocol session identity, transactional claims, leases, causal event envelope, and Claude/Codex handoff dogfood. Rally facilitates; hosts execute. Target design: docs/PROTOCOL-NORTH-STAR.md. Build plan: docs/PLAN-protocol-claim-authority-dogfood.md.

tasks.intent: Add structured resource scopes, access modes, canonicalization, and conflict rules.
tasks.output: canonical scope tests and conflict policy tests pass

tasks.intent: Add claim leases, mutable renewal, durable expiry, and rebuild from ledger.
tasks.output: lease renewal is non-durable; expiry emits exactly one durable event

tasks.intent: Add causal/idempotency fields and advisory authorization checks.
tasks.output: old logs replay and privileged events enforce role policy

tasks.intent: Wire new protocol modules into CLI/store/output without changing their internal contracts.
tasks.output: existing commands still replay old ledgers and new protocol commands work

tasks.intent: Audit scheduler boundary, state projections, docs, and validation evidence.
